releaseGate.rule: Bundled Windows x64 media is accepted only when every artifact has exact bytes, SHA-256, source/provenance evidence and a passing offline health check. Credentials and tenant authorization remain first-run configuration.

policy.starterKitContains: metadata, source inputs, bundled Windows x64 media, lock contracts and verification instructions
policy.installerOwns: offline media, exact artifact hashes, Authenticode verification, package materialization, installation and rollback

pythonStrategy.reason: The wheelhouse is compiled/selected for CPython 3.12 cp312 on Windows x64. A per-user install avoids administrator elevation and USB drive-letter fragility.
pythonStrategy.reuseRule: Reuse only a healthy CPython 3.12 win_amd64 interpreter whose cache tag is cpython-312. Python 3.11, 3.13, non-CPython and other architectures do not satisfy this contract.
pythonStrategy.fallback: If no exact ABI-compatible interpreter is healthy, install the locked private 3.12.10 artifact; never silently switch ABI.

artifacts.purpose: CPython runtime for local data, document, PDF, media and optional stateful Skills

integrity.sha256Source: SHA-256 of runtime/bundled/python-3.12.10-amd64.exe; downloaded from the official Python release URL.

authenticode.evidence: Get-AuthenticodeSignature returned Valid on the bundled installer.

install.path: Do not edit system PATH; record absolute python.exe and expose CODEX_PYTHON only in the private runtime record.

artifacts.healthCheck: & $env:CODEX_PYTHON -c "import platform,sys,sysconfig; assert sys.version_info[:2] == (3,12); assert sys.implementation.cache_tag == 'cpython-312'; assert sysconfig.get_platform() == 'win-amd64'; assert platform.machine() in ('AMD64','x86_64')"
artifacts.uninstallUpgrade: Use Windows installed-app uninstall for the same per-user version; upgrade only after a new exact media lock and health check. Never delete an unrelated Python installation.

artifacts.purpose: Complete offline Python wheelhouse for Skills that retain real Python functionality

source.indexPolicy: approved package index; record the index URL and timestamp in the private media manifest

integrity.sha256Source: Each of the 52 bundled wheels has an individual SHA-256 in runtime/bundled/python-wheelhouse-manifest.json and is verified before installation.

authenticode.evidence: per-wheel SHA-256, PyPI/index provenance and signed media manifest

artifacts.uninstallUpgrade: Install a new versioned per-user environment and switch the runtime pointer only after all wheel hashes and import checks pass; retain the old environment for rollback.

artifacts.purpose: Optional Node.js runtime for the locked official Feishu/Lark MCP package

integrity.sha256Source: SHA-256 of runtime/bundled/node-v20.20.0-win-x64.zip; matches the official Node.js SHASUMS256.txt.

authenticode.evidence: Official SHASUMS256.txt plus exact archive hash; ZIP archives do not carry Authenticode signatures.

install.path: User-local runtime pointer and PATH entry; no administrator elevation.

artifacts.offlineConstraint: Never use npx --yes for a health check or enabled Codex configuration. The package must already be present in the private cache and npm must run with --offline.
artifacts.uninstallUpgrade: Manage through Windows installed apps; upgrade Node and the MCP package together under a new media lock.

artifacts.purpose: Offline npm package cache for the official Feishu/Lark MCP

source.integrity: bundled package-lock.json preserves npm integrity for the 195-package closure

install.configCommand: Use the private wrapper command from config-fragments/feishu-official-stdio.template.toml; do not put App Secret in Codex TOML.

artifacts.offlineConstraint: The bundled ZIP contains the locked npm node_modules closure and package-lock.json. The installer extracts it without network access; Feishu still remains disabled until credentials and tenant permissions are supplied.
